title: A job is still in Pending Acceptance — what do I do?
keywords: pending acceptance not accepted no driver no taker unaccepted find a driver top up
body: 1. Call drivers already en route nearby and use Find a Driver.
2. Leftover jobs: give them to an agent already assigned and heading to the same cluster, zone, postal sector or collection point (same seller).
3. Top up in steps (see Top-up rules) until the fee matches the outsource cost, no later than 30 mins before the pickup window ends.
4. Still no taker: match the Lalamove price in uParcel for 10 mins, send a notification and push to Urgent.
5. Still no taker: movable job → move to the next slot/day and log it in the Move-over file. Non-movable → outsource via the Lalamove API in the Admin portal.
Never outsource SGH jobs — refer them to Hamyzan. TikTok jobs are never moved to the next day.
